title: P-role3: role 1 need not be named banned
description: Changes the approved .3 plan rule 'role 1 named banned'. room-policy-04 §8.1.3 says a banned role 'does not have to exist', so a role 1 with another name is a legal ordinary role. Chosen: validate() does not require role 1 to be named banned; Role::is_banned_role() (index 1 AND name 'banned') identifies the banned role, and .3.9 uses it for canBan/canUnban.
